sbcf.effect_boundary: Real loopback HTTP effect mediated through the accepted DGAF capability PEP and exact action digest; direct process code can still bypass the reference wrapper.
sbcf.scope: Bounded application-level real-effect adapter plus same-operator off-host witness/generation-floor runtime QA; no OS-level interception or bypass-resistant enforcement.

acs.effect_boundary: Reference host hook/policy decision runtime; reproduced tests do not establish the same committed external effect boundary as OpenShell.
acs.scope: Pinned upstream reference suite and bounded host behavior; no claim beyond the reproduced reference implementation.

openshell.effect_boundary: Docker-backed sandbox network enforcement at a real effect boundary.
openshell.scope: Default deny, live scoped allow, unrelated-host denial, and L7 POST denial in the reproduced sandbox policy path.
